justifications.durability: the updated stand-ins assert independent reason literals, such as tests/test_crew_recovery.py:2863 asserting signalled == [(4242, "budget-watchdog")] against the value recovery.py:3042 supplies, and logs/negative-control.log shows reinstating one (pid, start_time) signature reddens that test again.

justifications.fit: the edits follow the surrounding monkeypatch idiom and the existing signalled-list pattern in tests/test_crew.py:2691, introduce no name the naming rules forbid, and ruff format --check reports the six files already formatted.
justifications.goal_fidelity: git diff 825bf5bc8..2e1dfcd31 touches the eleven named stand-ins in tests/test_crew.py, tests/test_crew_lane_change.py, tests/test_crew_recovery.py, tests/test_receipt_after_release.py, tests/test_terminal_run_elapsed.py and tests/test_worker_env_export.py, and logs/head-arm.log shows all six files passing.
